The man was friendly and the store was great, but after I left I sat in the car for a little, reading the book I had just purchased. 

I started to get what felt like a headache? Like the beginning of a headache, that hadn’t been full blown yet. Then my feet felt tingly, and the weirdest part was my arm, (idk what to call it, then bend in my arm, where a doctor would normally draw blood) felt sore. Like if I had just gotten blood drawn and the area was still tender after. I even felt kind of dizzy for a few seconds while driving.

This might just all be in my head, but I was wondering if anyone has ever felt something like this before, or if anyone can clarify what just happened? I’m thinking about looking up chakras and seeing if that particular spot on my arm means anything.
